surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of TiCl4 and NH3 on the substrate, followed by the desorption of by-products such as HCl and N2. The pump-down steps enhance the removal of residual reactants and by-products, improving the film quality by reducing Cl impurities.
evidence: The reaction of 2TiCl4(g) + 4NH3(g) ⇒ 2TiN(s) + 8HCl(g) + N2(g) + 2H2(g) is discussed, indicating the formation of TiN and the release of by-products such as HCl and N2. The pump-down steps are mentioned to improve the removal of residual reactants and by-products, which affects the Cl concentration in the films.
